name: MarkupCraft
changes_to_copied_files: Renamed pdf.worker.min.mjs, pdf.mjs, pdf.min.mjs, pdf.worker.mjs to .js (and every reference to them), so servers that do not know the .mjs type still serve them as JavaScript.
Library URLs written as /assets/vendor/<lib>/current/ are pinned to the versions listed in release.json.
notes: Print with markups (Ctrl+P) and a Pages menu: rotate, move, insert, delete and extract pages, with markups moving along. Slip-sheet a revised set, find text across sheets (Ctrl+F), save a flattened copy, and recover your work after a crash. Layers, arcs and angles, pictures and signatures, area cut-outs, spaces, sketch to scale, photos on markups, sheet links and bookmarks. Compare by changed lines or a whole set, a live legend, custom columns, XLSX and PDF summaries, BCF import. Open in TakeoffCraft. Better touch. Every word in language files, with a draft Spanish (Mexico) translation not yet reviewed.
